mechanism: Both drugs increase serum potassium through aldosterone antagonism (eplerenone) and natriuretic peptide potentiation (sacubitril/valsartan), creating significant hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider dose adjustments or alternative agents if potassium exceeds 5.5 mEq/L; contraindicated in baseline potassium >5.0 mEq/L or eGFR <30 mL/min.
